title: specpulse config
description: specpulse.config.json (or .specpulse.json) in the project root. Every field is optional.

title.description: Dashboard title. Default: package.json name, else the folder name.

outDir.description: Output folder (index.html, img/, history/). Add it to .gitignore.

dataFile.description: Data file with manual milestone status, milestone → specs and image approval.

roadmap.description: Markdown with the phase table: rows starting with | [N](link) | Name | How to test | Focus |.

phaseFile.description: Per-phase markdown with milestone rows | **N.M Name** | Delivery |. {n} = phase number.

idPattern.description: Regex for spec IDs: file names start with it, headings are '# <ID> · Title', commits cite it.

gallery.description: Enables the Gallery and Timeline sections.

sceneExt.description: When set, each <name><sceneExt> file is a scene; otherwise each reference image is one.

render.description: Shell command rendering one scene to PNG. Placeholders: {scene}, {out}, {name}.
